name: p3_cor2
statement: : {k : ℕ | Odd k ∧ k ∣ p3_fibsum k}.Infinite
closed: {k : ℕ | Odd k ∧ k ∣ p3_fibsum k}.Infinite
informal: infinitely many odd k divide F_1+...+F_k (also Conjecture 1 of the paper)
original: There are infinitely many odd integers $k$ such that $k$ divides the sum of the first $k$ Fibonacci numbers. [Conjecture 1: There are infinitely many odd integers $n$ that divide the sum of the first $n$ nonzero Fibonacci numbers.]
